name: Matsushige (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Matsushige town emblem in white: a ring of two curved strokes with pointed ends, enclosing an arc.
history: Municipal flag of Matsushige, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1961.

features.role: Matsushige town emblem — a ring of two curved strokes with pointed ends, enclosing an arc
